findings.message: usecase createProject: principal aggregate 'Project' has a local port but is missing from data.ports (materialize never sees IProjectRepository nor the Project shape; see T12)
A função declara apenas o port ChangeOrder, mas a operação também lê Client e Project; os ports Client e Project estão ausentes.
findings.suggestion: Declare os ports Client e Project para cobrir as entidades lidas pela operação.
